text: ZX81 WEATHER WALL 19 SEP 18:10Z. ALERT: FLASH FLOOD WARNING IN NEW YORK, SAN FRANCISC; HURRICANE SIGNATURE DUJUAN 980MB S CHINA; 2 MAJOR FIRES TATLANIKA, NIEBLA; HOT NIGHT 25C MUMBAI; TROPICAL NIGHT 24C TEHRAN, 24C ABIDJAN, 24C SANTO DOMING, 22C CAIRO, 22C BEIJING +2 MORE. 100 ZX81S ON WATCH.

image.alt: A 10x10 wall of 100 ZX81 screens rendering a live world weather map in 1-bit block graphics. Alerts: flash flood warning N USA, NW USA; DUJUAN 980MB S CHINA; sweltering night N INDIA 25C; 2 major fires: TATLANIKA, NIEBLA; 1 flood; hot night N ATLANTIC 24C, ARABIA 24C, TROP ATL 24C, E ASIA 22C, N AFRICA 22C, S CHINA 21C, CARIBBEAN 20C; drought emergency EUROPE, W AFRICA (GDACS). Hottest 30C at SANTO DOMING, coldest 11C at REYKJAVIK. Precipitation: rain areas and snow or wintry areas. Roughest seas at N PACIFIC. 6 further wildfires burning.
